description: This file defines the 'iron-selection' component, including the 'Polymer.IronSelection' class with methods for managing item selection states, such as get, clear, isSelected, setItemSelected, select, and toggle.

classes.name: Polymer.IronSelection
classes.description: A class for managing selection of items, supporting single and multiple selection modes, with callback support.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the selected item(s); array if multi is true, otherwise the single selected item or undefined.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all selections except those specified in the excludes array.

methods.name: isSelected
methods.description: Checks if a given item is currently selected.

methods.name: setItemSelected
methods.description: Sets the selection state for a specific item, updating the selection array and invoking the callback if provided.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Selects an item; toggles if multi is true, otherwise replaces current selection.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the selection state of an item.
